market_type: Cross-venue: Kalshi perpetual future vs exchange-listed future

origin.claim: A 24/7 listed perpetual and a session-based futures contract on the same metal cannot diverge indefinitely; when the basis exceeds its own cost of carry, the two must converge.
origin.status: structural - two real legs on two real venues

rules.entry: Basis >= 0.5% between the perpetual mid and the MOEX future mid.
rules.exit: Exit when the basis compresses below 0.1%.
rules.sizing: Target notional per leg, capped by each venue published liquidity.

thesis: Compare the Kalshi metal perpetual with the front MOEX future on the same metal. When the percentage spread between them is large enough to cover both venues fees, buy the cheaper venue and sell the more expensive one. Both legs are simulated with their own venue fill model.
